description.value: Bergdorf Goodman is a luxury department store founded in 1899 by Herman Bergdorf. According to Wikipedia, the store moved to its present location at Fifth Avenue and 58th Street in 1928, building its Beaux-Arts style Bergdorf Goodman Building on the site of the Cornelius Vanderbilt II House. That puts it across from the Plaza and the corner of Central Park, so window shopping here pairs well with a walk along Fifth Avenue. Representative Tripadvisor praise (search snapshot): “Great views over Central Park. Great decor.”. Representative watch-outs: “A 10 minute wait at the Jo Malone counter”.
